content: मनीषिन् {%a.%} [मनीषा-इनि] .²1 Wise, learned, intelligent, clever, thoughtful, prudent; अप्यर्थकामौ तस्यास्तां धर्म एव मनीषिणः <ls>R. 1. 25</ls>. .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> Praying, praising. --{%m.%} .²1 A wise or learned person, a sage, a paṇḍita; माननीयो मनीषिणाम् <ls>R. 1. 11</ls>; संस्कारवत्येव गिरा मनीषी <ls>Ku. 1. 28</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 39</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 44</ls>. .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> A singer, praiser.
